caption: A jet of steam from a wallpaper steamer plate softens old wallpaper, and the paper peels away in wet strips.

sa.check: A steamer plate is held against a papered wall.
Steam escapes from around the plate.
The wallpaper loosens where the plate has been.
The paper peels away in strips.
The strips look wet and darkened.
The steaming comes first and the peeling follows.

pc.expect: The steam escapes upward around the plate's edges and the loosened strips hang and fall downward.
pc.fail: The steam pours downward through the wall; or sinks and pools on the floor; or a loosened strip hangs upward from its top edge with nothing holding it; or a fallen strip rises toward the ceiling.

pc.expect: The paper goes from dry and stuck to wet, dark and limp where the steam reaches it, and comes away in soft floppy strips.
pc.fail: The paper stays dry and pale while peeling; or a strip snaps off as a rigid board; or the paper turns to liquid and runs down the wall; or a strip stretches like rubber as it is pulled.

pc.expect: The paper only loosens where the steam has been and loosened paper stays loose.
pc.fail: A loosened strip presses itself back onto the wall and sticks; or the paper loosens on a part of the wall the plate has not reached; or the paper dries pale again while the steamer works on it; or the paper loosens and re-sticks in turn.

pc.expect: The plate's path shows: the wall behind the peeled strips is bare and damp while paper away from the plate stays stuck.
pc.fail: The wall behind a peeled strip is dry and dusty; or paper comes away from a part of the wall the plate never touched; or the plate is held on the wall and the paper there stays dry and tight to the end of the clip.

pc.expect: One plate on one wall; strips come off the wall and neither appear nor vanish.
pc.fail: A strip vanishes in mid-air; or new paper appears on the bare wall; or the plate passes into the wall; or a second plate appears.

pc.expect: The wallpaper's pattern away from the peeled area and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The wallpaper's pattern changes; or the bare wall changes colour; or items in the room rearrange.
